### What is observed?

_Describe the misbehavior so that this can be reproduced by the team._

### What is the impact of the misbehavior?

_Document the impact of this ticket, so that its level of priority is clear to every reader. Who is impacted by the bug? Two sentences are ideal. Five sentences is a maximum._

### How to fix it?

_You can list implementation options, and document which ones have been preferred and why. You can also refer to a previous similar implementation when possible._

_You need a specific Definition of Done for this ticket, expressed as a todo list. For example:_

### Definition of Done

- [ ] analyze history of changes ...
- [ ] reproduce the misbehavior in isolated environment ...
- [ ] analyze metrics and logs ...
- [ ] inspect code involved in the issue ...
- [ ] write a new test in file ...
- [ ] add code to file ...
- [ ] pass `make lint`
- [ ] deploy in staging environment
- [ ] deploy in production environment
